Aspera Connect — install
========================

PHONE (do this first)
  Open on the phone:
  https://play.google.com/apps/internaltest/4701460117553190758
  Become a tester → Install from Play → Start for calls

PC
  https://github.com/ramchandragada/asperaconnect/raw/cursor/phone-contacts-sync-5b4f/dist/release/AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb
  Install → Aspera Connect → Show QR to pair → phone Scan PC QR

Relay: wss://aspera-connect-relay.onrender.com
